name: Semantic DSU Trap
description: Replaces the linear-algebraic text ("exact rank", "quadratic penalty") that triggered tree-based DFS algorithms with "Entity Unification" text that strongly triggers Disjoint Set Union (DSU) pattern matching. Models that blindly apply Kruskal's algorithm to connect the Core Entities will fail, as greedy edge selection on a tree incorrectly includes cheap edges that do not lie on the unique paths between targets.
